  <entry>
    <title>Coastal Temperature Network</title>
    <link href="https://erddap.marine.ie/erddap/tabledap/ICTempNetwork.html"/>
    <id>https://erddap.marine.ie/erddap/tabledap/ICTempNetwork.html</id>
    <updated>2026-11-25T11:31:04Z</updated>
    <content type="text">
Irish Coastal Temperature Network

cdm_data_type = TimeSeries
VARIABLES:
SiteName (Station ID)
longitude (degrees_east)
latitude (degrees_north)
Bay
year
month
time (Detection Time, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
Depth (m)
SeaTemperature (Sea Surface Temperature, degree_C)
QFlag (Quality Control Flags)
    </content>
  </entry>

Bay

month

  <entry>

Bunaveela water temperature profiles Time Series

cdm_data_type = TimeSeries

time (Date Time, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)

year
month
day
